audio_noisy.basis: Stock encoder's ordinary AUDIO bandwidth-extension choice.

inactive_nibble.basis: Empirical INACTIVE/BWE pattern from the labelled broadcast archive.

projection.layout: Each row starts with the mode octet followed by 32 payload octets.
projection.word_erasure_basis: The projection cannot supply a full word if any octet is unknown or unavailable.

markers.??: received octet with unknown clear value
markers.--: no packet receipt for this octet

transition_tags.outcome_basis: Conditional on the stock 13.2 kb/s SWB ACELP TRANSITION encoder. Some text-supported P1 and P2 labels disagree with the predicted pair.

core_history.scope: For 13.2 kb/s EVS, word bit 0 is the mode MSB. HQ bit 6 is directly received. TCX20 bit 8 is a conditional expectation from the preceding core. Only adjacent received modes within the same group enter the check.

intra_word.scope: Only applicable slots are listed. Word bits use half-open intervals. The allowed value bounds are inclusive. Conditional bits have no on-air score.

gsc_fields.scope: Half-open MSB-first word bit ranges. Each prediction excludes all other field values. Direct observations and received-word erasures are retained even on a mismatch. A slot may support multiple checks. Ineligible slots are omitted.

audio_noisy.basis: Stock encoder's ordinary AUDIO bandwidth-extension choice.

inactive_nibble.basis: Empirical INACTIVE/BWE pattern from the labelled broadcast archive.

noisy_pitch_fill.basis: Stock noisy AUDIO/TBE positive-pitch pulse codebook and range-coder padding.

hq_neighbors.basis: Continuous ordinary 13.2 kb/s SWB HQ coding across three adjacent words in one group.

observation_basis: Same-slot directly carried bits in the recorded packet archive. In the published summary schema, no_peer counts missing observed targets.
